title: Cyberpunk Metropolis At Night
content: A wide-angle shot of a futuristic cyberpunk metropolis at night. A lone silhouette stands on a wet, reflective balcony looking out at towering skyscrapers. A massive, pixelated blue hologram of a woman's face is projected on a building to the left. Elevated highways stretch across the chasm with flying vehicles drifting between buildings. Moody lighting with cool blue and warm amber tones, atmospheric haze, and wet textures.
